wholePhysicalScope: Native 17-vertex way 231111093 fixes the three-storey 7 Jana Kilińskiego street building. The former museum identity and matching address are pinned by mapped node 9341475660.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the historic three-storey street building, monopitch roof, prominent square-facing sign and projecting balconies. Close levels add glazing and rail details.
limitations: The native outline and two exact 2020 views establish the street building and major window and balcony layout. Roof height, plaque, medallion and obscured rear ground level are simplified estimates.
The original elevation field is unchanged. The model represents the Kilińskiego premises while used as the museum in August 2020. The adjacent address, interiors and later site are outside scope.
